name: Synthesis of Co(ttpp) (scale-up)
plain_text_description:
Purposes
To obtain more Co(ttpp) for Co(ttpp)(py)2(OTf) synthesis
References and modifications
AD-R10 (76% yield): x2 scale, n-hexane → n-heptane + petroleum ether
Analysis results
1H NMR in CDCl₃: Co(ttpp), 0.068% (mol) of Co(III)?, 0.2 eq. of heptane/petroleum ether 86% purity
1H NMR in DMSO: Co(ttpp), Co(III)?, heptane/petroleum ether
ICP-OES:
Obtained products or insights
Co(ttpp) 77%
Problems and possible countermeasures
Filtration was difficult: heptane  + petroleum ether → hexane

Procedure
RT 21.9 °C, RH 30%
Reaction
100 mL two-neck RBF with a stir bar, septum (natural rubber), reflux condenser, T-shaped connector, bubbler (with paraffin oil), Schlenk line (N₂, 1.25 atm), heat gun, magnetic stirrer, oil bath
Heat the flask in an oven at 120 °C for >1.5 h
Quickly assemble and evacuate the system while it is still hot (1.2 × 10⁻³ mbar)
Heat the flask and the bottom part of the reflux condenser with a heat gun (250 °C)
Backfill with N₂
Close the N₂ connection. Add TAPP and TrBr (plastic spatula) quickly
Cycle with N₂ slowly ×3
Add Et₃N
Add THF → dark green liquid
Start stirring (350 rpm) [10:45]
Cover the flask with aluminum foil
Wait for 1 hr
 → 0.1 mL + 400 µL of CDCl₃ → ¹H NMR M1 (U1.834; N PROTON20ppm; O1P 6, SW 22)
Stop stirring. Close the N₂ connection. Add CoCl₂ quickly. Purge with N₂ for 10 s. Close. Resume stirring. [12:30]
Bubble with N₂ for 30 min [12:32]
Heat to reflux (85 °C, oil bath) for 2 h [15:03] 
Cool down to RT
→ 0.1 mL + 400 µL of CDCl₃ → syringe filter (PVDF) → ¹H NMR M2 (U1.834; N PROTON20ppm; O1P 6, SW 22)
plain_text_observation:
Short-pad chromatography
Fritted funnel (x mL, por. 4), suction adapter, 250 mL RBF, T-connector, diaphragm pump
Add 30 g of neutral alumina
Add THF to fully wet the alumina
Add the reaction mixture
Elute with suction and THF until the eluate becomes pale red → 220 mL, alumina pad blue-green at the top, pale red at the bottom
Store in the fridge o/n
Rotovap
Dry under vacuum Schlenk line, 1 h

RT 21.9 °C, RH 32 %
CHCl₃ deacidification
250 mL RBF
Add basic alumina 40 g
Add CHCl₃ 150 mL and swirl
Fritted funnel (x mL, por. 4), suction adapter, 250 mL RBF, diaphragm pump
Filter the mixture under suction

Reprecipitation
Add 50 mL of purified CHCl₃ to the flask and sonicate → dark red solution
Add 280 mL of n-heptane, swirl, sonicate
Store in fridge (0 °C) for 1 h 20 min
Fritted funnel (x mL, por. 4), suction adapter, 250 mL RBF, diaphragm pump [fritted funnel could be smaller]
Filter the mixture under suction → dark brown filtrate
Filter the filtrate again → faint brown filtrate
Transfer & rinse w/ 2 x (12 mL of purified CHCl₃ + 40 mL of heptane)
Rinse with 2 × 30 mL of petroleum ether
Dry under vacuum (desiccator, diaphragm pump, 4 days) → reddish brown solid

Analysis
RT 21.8 °C, RH 39%
20 mL vial with PTFE sealing (tare: 15.29431 g)
Weigh
→ 1H NMR P (CDCl₃, DMSO; U1.834; N PROTON 20 ppm; O1P 6, SW 22) (dark red solution)
Store in the fridge
